description: Lakes: NWM Lakes is a polygon dataset with COMID. This is the operational lakes layer provided by OWP.

path.description: Source path. LakesConfig will inject preceding input path.
path.title: Path

buffered_path.description: Source path, with polygons buffered out (for validating duplicate lake points). LakesConfig will inject preceding input path.
buffered_path.title: Buffered Path

fp_associated_path.description: A temporary layer to read lakes from where flowpaths have been associated and attributes joined. Skips flowpath association.
fp_associated_path.title: Fp Associated Path

run.description: Flag to run NWM lakes input. Must be set to false if file is not present.
run.title: Run

improve_placement_ref_res.description: Flag to use reference reservoirs to improve placement of lakes.
improve_placement_ref_res.title: Improve Placement Ref Res

improve_placement_path.description: A temporary layer to read lakes from where flowpaths have been associated, attributes joined, and reference reservoirs folded in to improve placement. Skips reference reservoirs folding.
improve_placement_path.title: Improve Placement Path

use_cached_improve_placement.description: Use the cached layer stored at `improve_placement_path` regardless of whether the process is requested to run.
use_cached_improve_placement.title: Use Cached Improve Placement

flowpath_association_method.description: Type of flowpath association. Options are `polygon_outlet` or `nearest_point`
flowpath_association_method.title: Flowpath Association Method

search_radius_m.description: Distance from flowpath to search when associating flowpaths with points.
search_radius_m.title: Search Radius M

max_refres_search_distance_m.description: Distance between NWM lake and reference reservoirs used when improving NWM lake placement.
max_refres_search_distance_m.title: Max Refres Search Distance M

intersection_length_min_m.description: Minimum prefered intersection lenght when associating polygons with flowpaths. If the flowpath intersection is extremely short, it can sometimes be almost entirely on a long downstream flowpath.
intersection_length_min_m.title: Intersection Length Min M

id_field.description: ID field for NWM lakes input
id_field.title: Id Field

attrib_src_path.description: Source file for joining attributes from another file. It will be skipped if null.
attrib_src_path.title: Attrib Src Path

attrib_src_layer.description: Source file layer for importing attributes
attrib_src_layer.title: Attrib Src Layer

attrib_src_key.description: Source file key to match when importing attributes
attrib_src_key.title: Attrib Src Key

fields.description: Fields to retain from NWM lakes data. IDs and geometry will be kept by default.
fields.title: Fields

title: NWMLakeInput
